title: nan
authors: Mossel A.; Leichtfried M.; Kaltenriner C.; Kaufmann H.
key_contribution: Presents a low-cost UAV (SmartCopter) using a smartphone for mapping, localization, and navigation in unknown GPS-denied indoor environments with demonstrated experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
